payload.change_description: Restore the dropped negation in the card-type clause of src/payment/card.js validateCard so that valid Visa/MasterCard charges pass card-type validation instead of being rejected. The seed commit S1 inverted this check, causing every valid Visa/MasterCard charge to fail (payment error ratio 1.00). The change is a one-line restoration of the card-type clause.

citations.change: one-line card-type clause negation restoration in src/payment/card.js validateCard
card-type rejection in validateCard confirmed via error span card_valid=true

changed_surfaces: compose service payment (restart via docker compose up -d payment)
